an2.32:1.2: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmīti.
an2.32:1.3: evambhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an2.32:2.3: asabbhihetaṃ bhikkhave upaññātaṃ yadidaṃ akataññutā akataveditā.
an2.32:2.4: kevalā esā bhikkhave asappurisabhūmi yadidaṃ akataññutā akataveditā. katamā ca bhikkhave sappurisabhūmi?
an2.32:2.5: sappuriso ca kho bhikkhave kataññū hoti katavedī.
an2.32:2.6: sabbhihetaṃ bhikkhave upaññātaṃ yadidaṃ kataññutā kataveditā.
an2.32:2.7: kevalā esā bhikkhave sappurisabhūmi yadidaṃ kataññutā kataveditāti.
an2.33:1.4: ekena bhikkhave aṃsena mātaraṃ parihareyya, ekena aṃsena pitaraṃ parihareyya vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī. so ca nesaṃ ucchādanaparimaddananahāpanasambāhanena,
an2.33:1.5: tepi tattheva muttakarīsaṃ cajeyyuṃ. natveva bhikkhave mātāpitunnaṃ kataṃ vā hoti, patikataṃ vā.
an2.33:1.6: imissā ca bhikkhave mahāpaṭhaviyā pahūtasattaratanāya mātāpitaro issarādhipacce rajje patiṭṭhāpeyya, natveva bhikkhave mātāpitunnaṃ kataṃ vā hoti, patikataṃ vā.
an2.33:1.8: bahukārā bhikkhave mātāpitaro puttānaṃ āpādakā posakā, imassa lokassa dassetāro.
an2.33:1.9: yo ca kho bhikkhave mātāpitaro assaddhe saddhāsampadāya samādapeti, niveseti, patiṭṭhāpeti, dussīle sīlasampadāya samādapeti, niveseti, patiṭṭhāpeti, maccharī cāgasampadāya samādapeti, niveseti, patiṭṭhāpeti, duppaññe paññāsampadāya samādapeti, niveseti, patiṭṭhāpeti, ettāvatā kho bhikkhave mātāpitunnaṃ katañca hoti patikatañca atikatañcāti
an2.34:1.1: atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an2.34:1.4: [brāhmaṇo:] yathākathaṃ pana bhavaṃ gotamo kiriyavādī ca akiriyavādī cāti?
an2.34:2.1: [bhagavā:] akiriyaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa vadāmi kāyaduccaritassa vacīduccaritassa manoduccaritassa, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ akiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an2.34:2.2: kiriyañca kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa vadāmi kāyasucaritassa vacīsucaritassa manosucaritassa, anekavihitānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ kiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an2.34:2.3: evaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa kiriyavādī ca akiriyavādī cāti.
an2.34:3.1: [brāhmaṇo:] abhikkantaṃ bho gotama …pe… upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an2.35:1.1: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an2.35:1.2: kati nu kho bhante loke dakkhiṇeyyā? kattha ca dānaṃ dātabbanti?
an2.35:1.5: ime kho gahapati dve loke dakkhiṇeyyā. ettha ca dānaṃ dātabbanti,
an2.35:2.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
an2.36:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an2.36:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sāriputto sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
an2.36:1.4: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi,
an2.36:1.6: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an2.36:1.9: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha. bhāsissāmīti.
an2.36:1.10: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an2.36:2.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an2.36:2.3: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an2.36:2.4: so tato cuto āgāmī hoti āgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:2.5: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso ajjhattasaññojano puggalo āgāmī āgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:3.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti. pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī. samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an2.36:3.3: so aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an2.36:3.4: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an2.36:3.5: so tato cuto anāgāmī hoti. anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:3.6: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bahiddhāsaññojano puggalo anāgāmī anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:4.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an2.36:4.2: so kāmānaṃ yeva nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
an2.36:4.3: so bhavānaṃ yeva nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
an2.36:4.6: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an2.36:4.7: so tato cuto anāgāmī hoti. anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an2.36:4.8: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bahiddhāsaññojano puggalo anāgāmī anāgantā itthattanti.
an2.36:5.1: athakho sambahulā samacittā devatā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an2.36:5.2: eso bhante āyasmā sāriputto pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde bhikkhūnaṃ ajjhattasaññojanañca puggalaṃ deseti, bahiddhāsaññojanañca.
an2.36:5.4: sādhu bhante bhagavā yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkamatu, anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an2.36:5.6: atha kho bhagavā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva jetavane antarahito pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde āyasmato sāriputtassa pamukhe pāturahosi.
an2.36:5.8: āyasmāpi kho sāriputto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an2.36:5.9: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca :
an2.36:6.1: idha sāriputta sambahulā samacittā devatā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sāriputta tā devatā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
an2.36:6.2: eso bhante āyasmā sāriputto pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde, bhikkhūnaṃ ajjhattasaññojanañca puggalaṃ deseti bahiddhāsaññojanañca.
an2.36:6.4: sādhu bhante bhagavā yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
an2.36:6.5: tā kho pana sāriputta devatā dasapi hutvā vīsampi hutvā tiṃsampi hutvā cattārīsampi hutvā paññāsampi hutvā saṭṭhimpi hutvā āraggakoṭinittuddanamattepi tiṭṭhanti na ca aññamaññaṃ vyābādhenti.
an2.36:6.6: siyā kho pana te sāriputta evamassa.
an2.36:6.7: tattha nūna tāsaṃ devatānaṃ tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ yena tā devatā dasapi hutvā vīsampi hutvā tiṃsampi hutvā cattārīsampi hutvā paññāsampi hutvā saṭṭhimpi hutvā āraggakoṭinittuddanamattepi tiṭṭhanti na ca aññamaññaṃ vyābādhenti.
an2.36:6.8: na kho panetaṃ sāriputta evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an2.36:6.9: idheva sāriputta tāsaṃ devatānaṃ tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ yena tā devatā dasapi hutvā vīsampi hutvā tiṃsampi hutvā cattārīsampi hutvā paññāsampi hutvā saṭṭhimpi hutvā āraggakoṭinittuddana mattepi tiṭṭhanti. na ca aññamaññaṃ vyābādhentīti.
an2.36:6.13: santindriyānaṃ hi vo sāriputta santamānasānaṃ santaṃ yeva kāyakammaṃ bhavissati santaṃ vacīkammaṃ santaṃ manokammaṃ,
an2.36:6.16: anassuṃ kho sāriputta aññatitthiyā paribbājakā ye imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ na assosunti.
an2.37:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno varaṇāyaṃ viharati kaddamadahatīre.
an2.37:1.3: atha kho ārāmadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākaccānena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an2.37:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ārāmadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca :
an2.37:1.5: ko nu kho bho kaccāna, hetu, ko paccayo yena khattiyāpi khattiyehi vivadanti, brāhmaṇāpi brāhmaṇehi vivadanti, gahapatikāpi gahapatikehi vivadantīti?
an2.37:1.6: [mahākaccāno:] kāmarāgavinivesavinibandhapaligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānahetu kho brāhmaṇa, khattiyāpi khattiyehi vivadanti, brāhmaṇāpi brāhmaṇehi vivadanti, gahapatikāpi gahapatikehi vivadantīti.
an2.37:2.1: [ārāmadaṇḍo:] ko pana bho kaccāna, hetu ko paccayo yena samaṇāpi samaṇehi vivadantīti?
an2.37:3.1: [ārāmadaṇḍo:] atthi pana bho kaccāna, koci lokasmiṃ yo imaṃ ceva kāmarāgavinivesavinibandhapaligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto, imaṃ ca diṭṭhirāgavinivesavinibandhapaligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkantoti?
an2.37:3.2: [mahākaccāno:] atthi brāhmaṇa lokasmiṃ yo imañceva kāmarāgavinivesavinibandhapaligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto, imañcadiṭṭhirāgavinivesavinibandhapaligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkantoti.
an2.37:4.1: [ārāmadaṇḍo:] ko pana so bho kaccāna, lokasmiṃ yo imañceva kāmagarāgavinivesavinibandhapaligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto, imañca diṭṭhirāgavinivesavinibandhapaligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkantoti?
an2.37:4.2: [mahākaccāno:] atthi brāhmaṇa, puratthimesu janapadesu sāvatthī nāma nagaraṃ.
an2.37:4.3: tattha so bhagavā etarahi viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
an2.37:4.4: so hi brāhmaṇa, bhagavā imañceva kāmarāgavinivesavinibandhapaligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto, imañca diṭṭhirāgavinivesavinibandhapaligedhapariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkantoti.
an2.37:5.1: evaṃ vutte ārāmadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇaṃ jāṇumaṇḍalaṃ puthuviyaṃ nihantvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi :
an2.37:9.1: yo hi so bhagavā imañceva kāmarāgavinivesavinibandha paligedha pariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto, imañca diṭṭhirāgavinivesavinibandha paligedha pariyuṭṭhānajjhosānaṃ samatikkantoti.
an2.37:10.2: seyyathāpi bho kaccāna nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evamevaṃ bhotā kaccānena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an2.37:10.3: esāhaṃ bho kaccāna taṃ bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
an2.37:10.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ kaccāno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an2.38:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno madhurāyaṃ viharati gundāvane.
an2.38:1.2: atha kho kaṇḍarāyaṇo brāhmaṇo yenāyasmā mahākaccāno, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākaccānena saddhiṃ …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho kaṇḍarāyaṇo brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca :
an2.38:1.3: sutaṃ metaṃ bho kaccāna, na samaṇo kaccāno brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetīti.
an2.38:1.5: nahi bhavaṃ kaccāno brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti.
an2.38:2.1: atthi brāhmaṇa, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena vuddhabhūmi ca akkhātā daharabhūmi ca.
an2.38:2.2: vuddho cepi brāhmaṇa hoti āsītiko vā nāvutiko vā vassasatiko vā jātiyā, so ca kāme paribhuñjati, kāmamajjhāvasati, kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhati, kāmavitakkehi khajjati, kāmapariyesanāya ussukko.
an2.38:2.3: atha kho so bālo ttheva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an2.38:2.4: daharo cepi brāhmaṇa, hoti yuvā susukālakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā.
an2.38:2.5: so ca na kāme paribhuñjati, na kāmamajjhāvasati, na kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhati, na kāmavitakkehi khajjati, na kāmapariyesanāya ussukko.
an2.38:2.6: atha kho so paṇḍito therotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti.
an2.38:3.1: evaṃ vutte kaṇḍarāyaṇo brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā daharānaṃ sudaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde sirasā vandati :
an2.38:4.1: abhikkantaṃ bho kaccāna …pe… upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ kaccāno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an2.39:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye corā balavanto honti, rājāno tasmiṃ samaye dubbalā honti.
an2.39:1.2: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye rañño na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā nīyātuṃ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṃ.
an2.39:1.3: brāhmaṇagahapatikānampi tasmiṃ samaye na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā nīyātuṃ vā bāhirāni vā kammantāni paṭivekkhituṃ.
an2.39:1.4: evameva kho bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye pāpabhikkhū balavanto honti, pesalā bhikkhū tasmiṃ samaye dubbalā honti.
an2.39:1.5: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye pesalā bhikkhū tuṇhībhūtā tuṇhībhūtā saṅghamajjhe saṃkasāyanti paccantime vā janapade bhajanti.
an2.39:1.6: tayidaṃ bhikkhave hoti bahujanāhitāya bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an2.39:2.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye rājāno balavanto honti, corā tasmiṃ samaye dubbalā honti.
an2.39:2.2: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye rañño phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā nīyātuṃ vā, paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṃ.
an2.39:2.3: brāhmaṇagahapatikānampi tasmiṃ samaye phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā nīyātuṃ vā, bāhirāni vā kammantāni paṭivekkhituṃ.
an2.39:2.4: evamevaṃ kho bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye pesalā bhikkhū balavanto honti, pāpabhikkhū tasmiṃ samaye dubbalā honti.
an2.39:2.5: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye pāpabhikkhū tuṇhībhūtā tuṇhībhūtā saṅghamajjhe saṃkasāyanti, yena vā pana tena papatanti.
an2.39:2.6: tayidaṃ bhikkhave hoti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti.
an2.40:1.1: dvinnāhaṃ bhikkhave micchāpaṭipattiṃ na vaṇṇemi, gihissa vā pabbajitassa vā.
an2.40:1.2: gihī vā bhikkhave pabbajito vā micchāpaṭipanno micchāpaṭipattādhikaraṇahetu nārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
an2.40:2.1: dvinnāhaṃ bhikkhave sammāpaṭipattiṃ vaṇṇemi, gihissa vā pabbajitassa vā.
an2.40:2.2: gihī vā bhikkhave pabbajito vā sammāpaṭipanno sammāpaṭipattādhikaraṇahetu ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti.
an2.41:1.1: ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū duggahitehi suttantehi byañjanapatirūpakehi atthañca dhammañca paṭibāhanti, te bhikkhave bhikkhū bahujanāhitāya paṭipannā bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an2.41:1.2: bahuñca te bhikkhave bhikkhū apuññaṃ pasavanti. tevimaṃ saddhammaṃ antaradhāpenti.
an2.41:2.1: ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū suggahitehi suttantehi na byañjanapatirūpakehi atthañca dhammañca anulomenti, te bhikkhave bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an2.41:2.2: bahuñca te bhikkhave bhikkhū puññaṃ pasavanti. te cimaṃ saddhammaṃ ṭhapentīti.
